name: SIEM Detection Rule Library
description: Built a library of 30+ production-ready Splunk detection rules mapped to MITRE ATT&CK techniques. Rules cover credential access, lateral movement, persistence, and exfiltration TTPs. Each rule includes documentation, tuning notes, and false-positive context.

name: Network Traffic Forensics Lab
description: Analyzed a series of PCAP files to reconstruct a multi-stage intrusion: initial reconnaissance, C2 beaconing, data staging, and exfiltration over DNS. Documented IOCs, wrote Snort/Suricata rules to detect each stage, and produced a full kill-chain report.

name: Phishing Campaign Analysis & Playbook
description: Investigated a simulated spear-phishing campaign from initial email delivery through payload execution and persistence. Extracted and sandboxed malicious attachments, pivoted on IOCs across threat intel platforms, and built a repeatable phishing triage playbook.

name: Windows Memory Forensics Investigation
description: Performed memory forensics on a compromised Windows endpoint to identify injected shellcode, rogue processes, and attacker tooling living in memory. Used Volatility 3 plugins to enumerate processes, extract artifacts, and map findings to MITRE ATT&CK.

name: Azure Sentinel Detection Rules (KQL)
description: Developed a set of KQL-based detection rules for Microsoft Sentinel targeting cloud-native attack patterns: impossible travel, privileged role assignments, service principal abuse, and anomalous sign-in behavior. Rules are parameterized for easy threshold tuning.

name: Incident Response Runbooks
description: Created a collection of structured incident response runbooks for common SOC alert types: ransomware, credential stuffing, beaconing malware, and insider threat indicators. Each runbook follows the PICERL framework with decision trees, escalation paths, and evidence-collection checklists.

name: Threat Hunt: Living-off-the-Land Binaries
description: Conducted a hypothesis-driven threat hunt across endpoint telemetry searching for LOLBin abuse (certutil, mshta, regsvr32, wscript). Developed a hunting methodology, documented findings, and converted confirmed TTPs into persistent Splunk scheduled alerts.
